## Connection.transaction() method

Run `callback` inside a transaction, rolling back if it throws.

**Signature:**

```typescript
transaction<T>(callback: (connection: Connection) => Promise<T>): Promise<T>;
```

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;T&gt;

Whatever the callback resolves to, once the commit succeeds.

## Exceptions

Whatever the callback threw, after the rollback completes.

## Remarks

The callback receives a connection bound to the transaction — statements issued on the outer connection are \*not\* part of it. On sqlite, nested calls use savepoints, since sqlite has no true nested transactions.
